Copies the beatmaps, scores and skins you have in **osu!lazer** to **osu!stable**, only the ones stable doesn't have yet.

**Download `Exotique.exe` below and run it.** Nothing to install, Windows 10/11 64-bit.
Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the exe isn't code-signed yet: click **More info** → **Run anyway**.

**New in 2.4**
- **Skins**: a third tab copies your lazer skins to stable's Skins folder, with a preview of each one (hit circle in its combo colour, number and cursor). Skins already in stable are recognised, even under another folder name.
- **Undo the last copy**: one click removes from stable exactly what the last copy added (maps, scores, skins, collections). Files go to the Recycle Bin, and whatever you did in stable since then is kept.

**Also in Exotique**
- Scores go to stable's Local leaderboard with their replays (`scores.db` backed up first).
- **Beatmaps**, **Scores** and **Skins** each have a checkbox: copy only what you need.
- lazer is never modified, maps as folders or `.osz`, lazer collections merged into `collection.db`, a running osu! is detected and can be closed for you. English, Français, Русский.

After copying, launch osu!stable and press **F5** in song select for new maps. Your scores are in the **Local Ranking** leaderboard, your skins in **Options > Skin**.

---

**FR** · Copie vers osu!stable les maps, les scores et les skins de osu!lazer qu'il n'a pas encore. Nouveau : un onglet Skins avec aperçu, et un bouton pour annuler la dernière copie (tout ce qu'elle a ajouté est retiré, les fichiers vont à la corbeille). Si Windows bloque : **Informations complémentaires** → **Exécuter quand même**.

**RU** · Копирует в osu!stable карты, рекорды и скины из osu!lazer, которых там ещё нет. Новое: вкладка «Скины» с предпросмотром и кнопка отмены последнего копирования (всё добавленное убирается, файлы уходят в корзину). Если Windows блокирует: **Подробнее** → **Выполнить в любом случае**.
